summary: Backend authentication, dashboards, role boundaries, and admin subject creation passed. Browser testing passed teacher and student workflows plus mobile layout, but admin master-data navigation is broken after clicking any section.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking Classes (and the other admin master-data nav items) changes the header title but leaves Dashboard content rendered; Add record is unavailable.

action_items: Synchronize AdminView selected state with the page prop (or lift the state) so clicking Academic/Teachers/Students/Classes/Subjects/Teaching Assignments renders the selected records and add modal.
Filter the shared users collection by role in the Teachers versus Students admin views.
Move the hardcoded JWT SECRET to a backend environment variable and use a sufficiently long secret.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminView initializes selected from page only once; subsequent Sidebar setPage updates Header but not AdminView content, causing a core admin workflow failure.
CreateModal has no catch/error state, so an admin receives no feedback if POST fails.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Linear Algebra through the admin subject API and TEST Browser Class was not created because the UI navigation bug prevented the modal flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite and teacher/student browser paths pass. Retest admin navigation and modal POST after syncing AdminView state; then verify Teachers and Students lists are role-filtered.
rca of the issue: App renders <AdminView page={page}> while AdminView stores const [selected,setSelected]=useState(page). Sidebar changes page via setPage, but selected is never updated from page. Header reads page and changes, while AdminView continues rendering its original Dashboard branch.
